prompt_md: How many different ways can you arrange the four letters of the word NOON, counting NOON itself?
prompt_short: Arrangements of the letters of NOON?
hint_md: Swapping the two Os changes nothing.
explain_intuition_md: 24 would be right if all four letters were different. But swapping the two Ns, or the two Os, gives the same word, so you divide by 2 twice.
